text: The purpose of this report is to propose the installation of a U-turn prohibition for westbound traffic on Trethewey Drive. This proposed U-Turn prohibition will address safety concerns and reduce vehicle conflicts on Trethewey Drive, west of Black Creek Drive. It is recommended that westbound U-turns be prohibited anytime on Trethewey Drive, between Black Creek Drive and a point 90 metres west of Todd Baylis Boulevard. As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates transit service on Trethewey Drive, City Council approval of this report is required.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit U-turn movements at all times for westbound traffic on Trethewey Drive, between Black Creek Drive and a point 90 metres west of Todd Baylis Boulevard.
